column1: # tools/realtime/alloc_vocabulary.tsv -- the canonical allocation vocabulary (E169 D-2).
# The frozen `spinel_alloc_free.py`'s 5 sets + allow list are kept in **one file**, and both the native
# `spinel-rtcheck` and the native undef gate (`UndefGate.cpp`) take them from here.
# It is embedded into C++ as `AllocVocabulary.inc` at configure time — the binaries do not read
# this file at run time (the undef gate runs on a user's machine with build/bin alone).
#   pause        stops the world (SEEDS_PAUSE). Not an allocation — do not mix them
#   abort_hint   does not return to the caller (ABORT_HINTS). Information only (the decision is per block)
#   setjmp       may re-enter the frame (SETJMP). --allow-abort refuses when one is present
#   constructor  not a seed, but means the same thing (the rest of the undef gate's 31 words)
#   allow        libc / libm words that do not allocate even without a body
#   allow_prefix prefixes that do not allocate even without a body
#   allow_regex  the same as a regex. **`[a-z]+f` also lets the printf family through** — a soundness hole
#                in the frozen Python, copied for byte equality in E169 (D-6; the fix belongs to a separate experiment)
